verses.en: And Shelomoh the son of Dawid was strengthened in his kingdom, and YAHUAH his YAHUAH was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.am: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God {was} with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

verses.en: Then Shelomoh spake unto all Yisra'el, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Yisra'el, the chief of the fathers.
verses.am: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

verses.en: So Shelomoh, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of YAHUAH, which Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH had made in the wilderness.
verses.am: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that {was} at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

verses.en: But the ark of YAHUAH had Dawid brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which Dawid had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to {the place which} David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

verses.en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of YAHUAH: and Shelomoh and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.am: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it. {he put: or, was there}

verses.en: And Shelomoh went up thither to the brasen altar before YAHUAH, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.am: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which {was} at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

verses.en: In that night did YAHUAH appear unto Shelomoh, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.am: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

verses.en: And Shelomoh said unto YAHUAH, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto Dawid my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.am: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

verses.en: Now, O YAHUAH, let thy promise unto Dawid my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.am: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude. {like...: Heb. much as the dust of the earth}

verses.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.am: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, {that is so} great?

verses.en: And YAHUAH said to Shelomoh, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.am: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

verses.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.am: Wisdom and knowledge {is} granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that {have been} before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

verses.en: Then Shelomoh came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Yerushalayim, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Yisra'el.
verses.am: Then Solomon came {from his journey} to the high place that {was} at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

verses.en: And Shelomoh gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the king made silver and gold at Yerushalayim as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.am: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem {as plenteous} as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that {are} in the vale for abundance. {made: Heb. gave}

verses.en: And Shelomoh had horses brought out of Mitsrayim, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.am: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price. {Solomon...: Heb. the going forth of the horses which was Solomon's}

verses.en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Mitsrayim a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.am: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred {shekels} of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out {horses} for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means. {means: Heb. hand}

verses.en: And Shelomoh determined to build an house for the name of YAHUAH, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.am: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

verses.en: And Shelomoh told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.am: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

verses.en: And Shelomoh sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with Dawid my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.am: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, {even so deal with me}. {Huram: or, Hiram}

verses.en: Behold, I build an house to the name of YAHUAH my YAHUAH, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of YAHUAH our YAHUAH. This is an ordinance for ever to Yisra'el.
verses.am: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate {it} to him, {and} to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This {is an ordinance} for ever to Israel. {sweet...: Heb. incense of spices}

verses.en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our YAHUAH above all elohim.
verses.am: And the house which I build {is} great: for great {is} our God above all gods.

verses.en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.am: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who {am} I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him? {is able: Heb. hath retained, or, obtained strength}

verses.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Yehudah and in Yerushalayim, whom Dawid my father did provide.
verses.am: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that {are} with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide. {to grave: Heb. to grave gravings}

verses.en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.am: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants {shall be} with thy servants, {algum: also called, almuggim}

verses.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.am: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build {shall be} wonderful great. {wonderful...: Heb. great and wonderful}

verses.en: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.am: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

verses.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Shelomoh, Because YAHUAH hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.am: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

verses.en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to Dawid the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for YAHUAH, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.am: Huram said moreover, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom. {endued...: Heb. knowing prudence and understanding}

verses.en: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
verses.am: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

verses.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord Dawid thy father.
verses.am: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father {was} a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

verses.en: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.am: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

verses.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem. {as much...: Heb according to all thy need} {Joppa: Heb. Japho}

verses.en: And Shelomoh numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Yisra'el, after the numbering wherewith Dawid his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.am: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that {were} in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred. {the strangers: Heb. the men the strangers}

verses.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.am: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them {to be} bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand {to be} hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

verses.en: Then Shelomoh began to build the house of YAHUAH at Yerushalayim in mount Moriah, where YAHUAH appeared unto Dawid his father, in the place that Dawid had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.am: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where {the LORD} appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite. {where...: or, which was seen of David his father} {Ornan: also called, Araunah}

verses.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.am: And he began to build in the second {day} of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.en: Now these are the things wherein Shelomoh was instructed for the building of the house of YAHUAH. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.am: Now these {are the things wherein} Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure {was} threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits. {instructed: Heb. founded}

verses.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.am: And the porch that {was} in the front {of the house}, the length {of it was} according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height {was} an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

verses.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.am: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

verses.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.am: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold {was} gold of Parvaim. {garnished: Heb. covered}

verses.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.am: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

verses.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.am: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof {was} according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, {amounting} to six hundred talents.

verses.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.am: And the weight of the nails {was} fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

verses.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.am: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold. {image...: or, (as some think) of moveable work}

verses.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.am: And the wings of the cherubims {were} twenty cubits long: one wing {of the one cherub was} five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing {was likewise} five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.am: And {one} wing of the other cherub {was} five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing {was} five cubits {also}, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.am: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces {were} inward. {inward: or, toward the house}

verses.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.am: And he made the vail {of} blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon. {wrought: Heb. caused to ascend}

verses.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.am: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that {was} on the top of each of them {was} five cubits. {high: Heb. long}

verses.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.am: And he made chains, {as} in the oracle, and put {them} on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put {them} on the chains.

verses.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.am: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz. {Jachin: that is, He shall establish} {Boaz: that is, In it is strength}

verses.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.am: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

verses.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.am: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about. {from...: Heb. from his brim to his brim}

verses.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.am: And under it {was} the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen {were} cast, when it was cast.

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.am: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea {was set} above upon them, and all their hinder parts {were} inward.

verses.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.am: And the thickness of it {was} an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; {and} it received and held three thousand baths. {with flowers...: or, like a lilyflower}

verses.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.am: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea {was} for the priests to wash in. {such...: Heb. the work of burnt offering}

verses.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.am: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set {them} in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

verses.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.am: He made also ten tables, and placed {them} in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold. {basons: or, bowls}

verses.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.am: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

verses.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.am: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

verses.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Shelomoh for the house of YAHUAH;
verses.am: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God; {basons: or, bowls} {finished: Heb. finished to make}

verses.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.am: {To wit}, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters {which were} on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which {were} on the top of the pillars;

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.am: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which {were} upon the pillars. {upon: Heb. upon the face of}

verses.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.am: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases; {lavers: or, caldrons}

verses.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.am: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

verses.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Shelomoh for the house of YAHUAH of bright brass.
verses.am: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass. {bright: Heb. made bright, or, scoured}

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.am: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah. {clay...: Heb. thicknesses of the ground}

verses.en: Thus Shelomoh made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.am: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

verses.en: And Shelomoh made all the vessels that were for the house of YAHUAH, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.am: And Solomon made all the vessels that {were for} the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread {was set};

verses.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.am: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

verses.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.am: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, {made he of} gold, {and} that perfect gold; {perfect...: Heb. perfections of gold}

verses.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.am: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, {of} pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy {place}, and the doors of the house of the temple, {were of} gold. {basons: or, bowls}

verses.en: Thus all the work that Shelomoh made for the house of YAHUAH was finished: and Shelomoh brought in all the things that Dawid his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in {all} the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

verses.en: Then Shelomoh assembled the elders of Yisra'el, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yisra'el, unto Yerushalayim, to bring up the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH out of the city of Dawid, which is Zion.
verses.am: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which {is} Zion.

verses.en: Wherefore all the men of Yisra'el assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
verses.am: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which {was} in the seventh month.

verses.en: And all the elders of Yisra'el came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.am: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.en: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.am: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that {were} in the tabernacle, these did the priests {and} the Levites bring up.

verses.en: Also king Shelomoh, and all the congregation of Yisra'el that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.am: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.am: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy {place, even} under the wings of the cherubims:

verses.en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.am: For the cherubims spread forth {their} wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.en: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.am: And they drew out the staves {of the ark}, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day. {there...: or, they are there}

verses.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Mosheh put therein at Horeb, when YAHUAH made a covenant with the children of Yisra'el, when they came out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: {There was} nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put {therein} at Horeb, when the LORD made {a covenant} with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt. {when the LORD: or, where, etc}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
verses.am: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy {place}: (for all the priests {that were} present were sanctified, {and} did not {then} wait by course: {present: Heb. found}

verses.en: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.am: Also the Levites {which were} the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, {being} arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

verses.en: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking YAHUAH; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised YAHUAH, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of YAHUAH;
verses.am: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers {were} as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up {their} voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, {saying}, For {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever: that {then} the house was filled with a cloud, {even} the house of the LORD;

verses.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of YAHUAH had filled the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

verses.en: Then said Shelomoh, YAHUAH hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.am: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.am: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

verses.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Yisra'el: and all the congregation of Yisra'el stood.
verses.am: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father Dawid, saying,
verses.am: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled {that} which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

verses.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Mitsrayim I chose no city among all the tribes of Yisra'el to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Yisra'el:
verses.am: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

verses.en: But I have chosen Yerushalayim, that my name might be there; and have chosen Dawid to be over my people Yisra'el.
verses.am: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

verses.en: Now it was in the heart of Dawid my father to build an house for the name of YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: But YAHUAH said to Dawid my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.am: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

verses.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.am: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

verses.en: YAHUAH therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of Dawid my father, and am set on the throne of Yisra'el, as YAHUAH promised, and have built the house for the name of YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of YAHUAH, that he made with the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And in it have I put the ark, wherein {is} the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

verses.en: And he stood before the altar of YAHUAH in the presence of all the congregation of Yisra'el, and spread forth his hands:
verses.am: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

verses.en: For Shelomoh had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Yisra'el, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.am: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven, {long...: Heb. the length thereof, etc}

verses.en: And said, O YAHUAH of Yisra'el, there is no YAHUAH like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.am: And said, O LORD God of Israel, {there is} no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and {shewest} mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

verses.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant Dawid my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.am: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled {it} with thine hand, as {it is} this day.

verses.en: Now therefore, O YAHUAH of Yisra'el, keep with thy servant Dawid my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Yisra'el; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.am: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me. {There...: Heb. There shall not a man be cut off}

verses.en: Now then, O YAHUAH of Yisra'el, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant Dawid.
verses.am: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

verses.en: But will YAHUAH in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.am: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

verses.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.am: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.am: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place. {toward...: or, in this place}

verses.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Yisra'el, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.am: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, {even} from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive. {make: Heb. pray} {toward...: or, in this place}

verses.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.am: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house; {and an oath...: Heb. and he require an oath of him}

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.am: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

verses.en: And if thy people Yisra'el be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.am: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house; {be put...: or, be smitten} {in: or, toward}

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Yisra'el, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.am: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

verses.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.am: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; {yet} if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them; {toward...: or, in this place}

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Yisra'el, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.am: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

verses.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.am: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness {there be}: {in the cities...: Heb. in the land of their gates}

verses.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Yisra'el, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.am: {Then} what prayer {or} what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house: {in: or, toward} {toward...: or, in this place}

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.am: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

verses.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.am: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers. {so long...: Heb. all the days which} {in the land: Heb. upon the face of the land}

verses.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Yisra'el, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.am: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house; {toward...: or, in this place}

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Yisra'el, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.am: Then hear thou from the heavens, {even} from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as {doth} thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name. {this...: Heb. thy name is called upon this house}

verses.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.am: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.am: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause. {cause: or, right}

verses.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.am: If they sin against thee, (for {there is} no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before {their} enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near; {they carry them away captives: Heb. they that take them captives carry them away}

verses.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.am: Yet {if} they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly; {bethink...: Heb. bring back to their heart}

verses.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.am: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and {toward} the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
verses.am: Then hear thou from the heavens, {even} from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee. {cause: or, right}

verses.en: Now, my YAHUAH, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.am: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and {let} thine ears {be} attent unto the prayer {that is made} in this place. {unto...: Heb. to the prayer of this place}

verses.en: Now therefore arise, O YAHUAH, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O YAHUAH, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.am: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of Dawid thy servant.
verses.am: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

verses.en: Now when Shelomoh had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of YAHUAH filled the house.
verses.am: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

verses.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of YAHUAH, because the glory of YAHUAH had filled YAHUAH's house.
verses.am: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.

verses.en: And when all the children of Yisra'el saw how the fire came down, and the glory of YAHUAH upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised YAHUAH, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, {saying}, For {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before YAHUAH.
verses.am: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

verses.en: And king Shelomoh offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

verses.en: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of YAHUAH, which Dawid the king had made to praise YAHUAH, because his mercy endureth for ever, when Dawid praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Yisra'el stood.
verses.am: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy {endureth} for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood. {by their...: Heb. by their hand}

verses.en: Moreover Shelomoh hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of YAHUAH: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Shelomoh had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
verses.am: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that {was} before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

verses.en: Also at the same time Shelomoh kept the feast seven days, and all Yisra'el with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

verses.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.am: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days. {a solemn...: Heb. a restraint}

verses.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that YAHUAH had shewed unto Dawid, and to Shelomoh, and to Yisra'el his people.
verses.am: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

verses.en: Thus Shelomoh finished the house of YAHUAH, and the king's house: and all that came into Shelomoh's heart to make in the house of YAHUAH, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
verses.am: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

verses.en: And YAHUAH appeared to Shelomoh by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
verses.am: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

verses.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
verses.am: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

verses.en: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.am: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land. {which...: Heb. upon whom my name is called}

verses.en: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.am: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer {that is made} in this place. {unto...: Heb. to the prayer of this place}

verses.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.am: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as Dawid thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
verses.am: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

verses.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with Dawid thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Yisra'el.
verses.am: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man {to be} ruler in Israel. {There...: Heb. There shall not be cut off to thee}

verses.en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other elohim, and worship them;
verses.am: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
verses.am: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it {to be} a proverb and a byword among all nations.

verses.en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath YAHUAH done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
verses.am: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

verses.en: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook YAHUAH of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Mitsrayim, and laid hold on other elohim, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
verses.am: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Shelomoh had built the house of YAHUAH, and his own house,
verses.am: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,

verses.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Shelomoh, Shelomoh built them, and caused the children of Yisra'el to dwell there.
verses.am: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

verses.en: And Shelomoh went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.am: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

verses.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.am: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

verses.en: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.am: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

verses.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Shelomoh had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Shelomoh desired to build in Yerushalayim, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.am: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion. {all that...: Heb. all the desire of Solomon which he desired to build}

verses.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Yisra'el,
verses.am: {As for} all the people {that were} left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which {were} not of Israel,

verses.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yisra'el consumed not, them did Shelomoh make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.am: {But} of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

verses.en: But of the children of Yisra'el did Shelomoh make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.am: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they {were} men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

verses.en: And these were the chief of king Shelomoh's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.am: And these {were} the chief of king Solomon's officers, {even} two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

verses.en: And Shelomoh brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of Dawid unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of Dawid king of Yisra'el, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of YAHUAH hath come.
verses.am: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because {the places are} holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come. {holy: Heb. holiness}

verses.en: Then Shelomoh offered burnt offerings unto YAHUAH on the altar of YAHUAH, which he had built before the porch,
verses.am: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,

verses.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Mosheh, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.am: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, {even} in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

verses.en: And he appointed, according to the order of Dawid his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had Dawid the man of YAHUAH commanded.
verses.am: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded. {so had David...: Heb. so was the commandment of David the man of God}

verses.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.am: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

verses.en: Now all the work of Shelomoh was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of YAHUAH, and until it was finished. So the house of YAHUAH was perfected.
verses.am: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. {So} the house of the LORD was perfected.

verses.en: Then went Shelomoh to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.am: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom. {Eloth: also called, Elath}

verses.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Shelomoh to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Shelomoh.
verses.am: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought {them} to king Solomon.

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Shelomoh, she came to prove Shelomoh with hard questions at Yerushalayim, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Shelomoh, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.am: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.en: And Shelomoh told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Shelomoh which he told her not.
verses.am: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Shelomoh, and the house that he had built,
verses.am: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

verses.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of YAHUAH; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.am: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her. {cupbearers: or, butlers}

verses.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
verses.am: And she said to the king, {It was} a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom: {report: Heb. word} {acts: or, sayings}

verses.en: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.am: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen {it}: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: {for} thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

verses.en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.am: Happy {are} thy men, and happy {are} these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for YAHUAH thy YAHUAH: because thy YAHUAH loved Yisra'el, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.am: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, {to be} king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

verses.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Shelomoh.
verses.am: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

verses.en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Shelomoh, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.am: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones. {algum...: also called, almug trees}

verses.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of YAHUAH, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Yehudah.
verses.am: And the king made {of} the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah. {terraces: or, stairs: Heb. highways}

verses.en: And king Shelomoh gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.am: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside {that} which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

verses.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Shelomoh in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.am: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

verses.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Shelomoh.
verses.am: Beside {that which} chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon. {governors: or, captains}

verses.en: And king Shelomoh made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
verses.am: And king Solomon made two hundred targets {of} beaten gold: six hundred {shekels} of beaten gold went to one target.

verses.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.am: And three hundred shields {made he of} beaten gold: three hundred {shekels} of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.am: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

verses.en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
verses.am: And {there were} six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, {which were} fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays: {stays: Heb. hands}

verses.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.am: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Shelomoh were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Shelomoh.
verses.am: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon {were of} gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon {were of} pure gold: none {were of} silver; it was {not} any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon. {pure: Heb. shut up} {none were of silver: or, there was no silver in them}

verses.en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.am: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks. {ivory: or, elephants' teeth}

verses.en: And king Shelomoh passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.am: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

verses.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Shelomoh, to hear his wisdom, that YAHUAH had put in his heart.
verses.am: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

verses.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.am: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.en: And Shelomoh had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. {river: that is, Euphrates}

verses.en: And the king made silver in Yerushalayim as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.am: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that {are} in the low plains in abundance. {made silver: Heb. gave silver}

verses.en: And they brought unto Shelomoh horses out of Mitsrayim, and out of all lands.
verses.am: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Shelomoh, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, {are} they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat? {book: Heb. words}

verses.en: And Shelomoh reigned in Yerushalayim over all Yisra'el forty years.
verses.am: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

verses.en: And Shelomoh slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of Dawid his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Yisra'el come to make him king.
verses.am: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Mitsrayim, whither he had fled from the presence of Shelomoh the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who {was} in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard {it}, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

verses.en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Yisra'el came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.am: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
verses.am: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.am: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

verses.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Shelomoh his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.am: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye {me} to return answer to this people?

verses.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.am: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

verses.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
verses.am: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

verses.en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
verses.am: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

verses.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.am: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou {it} somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little {finger} shall be thicker than my father's loins.

verses.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.am: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I {will chastise you} with scorpions. {my father put: Heb. my father laded}

verses.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.am: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

verses.en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.am: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

verses.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.am: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I {will chastise you} with scorpions.

verses.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of YAHUAH, that YAHUAH might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
