verses.am: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.en: And when all Yisra'el saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in Dawid? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Yisra'el: and now, Dawid, see to thine own house. So all Yisra'el went to their tents.
verses.am: And when all Israel {saw} that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and {we have} none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: {and} now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

verses.en: But as for the children of Yisra'el that dwelt in the cities of Yehudah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.am: But {as for} the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Yisra'el stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that {was} over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to {his} chariot, to flee to Jerusalem. {made speed: Heb. strengthened himself}

verses.en: And Yisra'el rebelled against the house of Dawid unto this day.
verses.am: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Yerushalayim, he gathered of the house of Yehudah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Yisra'el, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.am: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen {men}, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

verses.en: But the word of YAHUAH came to Shemaiah the man of YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

verses.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Shelomoh, king of Yehudah, and to all Yisra'el in Yehudah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.am: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of YAHUAH, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.am: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

verses.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Yerushalayim, and built cities for defence in Yehudah.
verses.am: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

verses.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.am: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

verses.en: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.am: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

verses.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.am: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

verses.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.am: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

verses.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Yehudah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.am: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which {are} in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

verses.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.am: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

verses.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Yehudah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.am: And in every several city {he put} shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Yisra'el resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.am: And the priests and the Levites that {were} in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts. {resorted...: Heb. presented themselves to him}

verses.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Yehudah and Yerushalayim: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto YAHUAH:
verses.am: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:

verses.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.am: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

verses.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Yisra'el such as set their hearts to seek YAHUAH of Yisra'el came to Yerushalayim, to sacrifice unto YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Yehudah, and made Rehoboam the son of Shelomoh strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of Dawid and Shelomoh.
verses.am: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

verses.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of Dawid to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.am: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, {and} Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

verses.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.am: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

verses.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.am: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith. {Maachah: she is also called Michaiah the daughter of Uriel}

verses.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.am: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

verses.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.am: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, {to be} ruler among his brethren: for {he thought} to make him king.

verses.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Yehudah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.am: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives. {many wives: Heb. a multitude of wives}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of YAHUAH, and all Yisra'el with him.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Mitsrayim came up against Yerushalayim, because they had transgressed against YAHUAH,
verses.am: And it came to pass, {that} in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,

verses.en: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Mitsrayim; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
verses.am: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people {were} without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

verses.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Yehudah, and came to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And he took the fenced cities which {pertained} to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Yehudah, that were gathered together to Yerushalayim because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.am: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and {to} the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

verses.en: Whereupon the princes of Yisra'el and the king humbled themselves; and they said, YAHUAH is righteous.
verses.am: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD {is} righteous.

verses.en: And when YAHUAH saw that they humbled themselves, the word of YAHUAH came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Yerushalayim by the hand of Shishak.
verses.am: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; {therefore} I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak. {some: or, a little while}

verses.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.am: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

verses.en: So Shishak king of Mitsrayim came up against Yerushalayim, and took away the treasures of the house of YAHUAH, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Shelomoh had made.
verses.am: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
verses.am: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed {them} to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

verses.en: And when the king entered into the house of YAHUAH, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
verses.am: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

verses.en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of YAHUAH turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Yehudah things went well.
verses.am: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy {him} altogether: and also in Judah things went well. {and also...: or, and yet in Judah there were good things}

verses.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Yerushalayim, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Yerushalayim, the city which YAHUAH had chosen out of all the tribes of Yisra'el, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.am: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam {was} one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name {was} Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD. {prepared: or, fixed}

verses.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.am: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, {are} they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And {there were} wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually. {book: Heb. words}

verses.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of Dawid: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead. {Abijah: also called, Abijam}

verses.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Yehudah.
verses.am: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

verses.en: He reigned three years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.am: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
verses.am: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, {even} four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, {being} mighty men of valour. {Abijah set: Heb. Abijah bound together}

verses.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Yisra'el;
verses.am: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which {is} in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

verses.en: Ought ye not to know that YAHUAH of Yisra'el gave the kingdom over Yisra'el to Dawid for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.am: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, {even} to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

verses.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Shelomoh the son of Dawid, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
verses.am: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

verses.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Shelomoh, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.am: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

verses.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of YAHUAH in the hand of the sons of Dawid; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for elohim.
verses.am: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye {be} a great multitude, and {there are} with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

verses.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of YAHUAH, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no elohim.
verses.am: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of {other} lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, {the same} may be a priest of {them that are} no gods. {to consecrate...: Heb. to fill his hand}

verses.en: But as for us, YAHUAH is our YAHUAH, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto YAHUAH, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
verses.am: But as for us, the LORD {is} our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, {are} the sons of Aaron, and the Levites {wait} upon {their} business:

verses.en: And they burn unto YAHUAH every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of YAHUAH our YAHUAH; but ye have forsaken him.
verses.am: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also {set they in order} upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

verses.en: And, behold, YAHUAH himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Yisra'el, fight ye not against YAHUAH of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
verses.am: And, behold, God himself {is} with us for {our} captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

verses.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Yehudah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.am: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment {was} behind them.

verses.en: And when Yehudah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto YAHUAH, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.am: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle {was} before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

verses.en: Then the men of Yehudah gave a shout: and as the men of Yehudah shouted, it came to pass, that YAHUAH smote Jeroboam and all Yisra'el before Abijah and Yehudah.
verses.am: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el fled before Yehudah: and YAHUAH delivered them into their hand.
verses.am: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

verses.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Yisra'el five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.am: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

verses.en: Thus the children of Yisra'el were brought under at that time, and the children of Yehudah prevailed, because they relied upon YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
verses.am: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

verses.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and YAHUAH struck him, and he died.
verses.am: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

verses.en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.am: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.am: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, {are} written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

verses.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.am: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

verses.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of YAHUAH his YAHUAH:
verses.am: And Asa did {that which was} good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

verses.en: For he took away the altars of the strange elohim, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
verses.am: For he took away the altars of the strange {gods}, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves: {images: Heb. statues}

verses.en: And commanded Yehudah to seek YAHUAH of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.am: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

verses.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Yehudah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.am: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him. {images: Heb. sun images}

verses.en: And he built fenced cities in Yehudah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because YAHUAH had given him rest.
verses.am: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

verses.en: Therefore he said unto Yehudah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought YAHUAH our YAHUAH, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.am: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about {them} walls, and towers, gates, and bars, {while} the land {is} yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought {him}, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

verses.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Yehudah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.am: And Asa had an army {of men} that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these {were} mighty men of valour.

verses.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
verses.am: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

verses.en: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.am: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

verses.en: And Asa cried unto YAHUAH his YAHUAH, and said, YAHUAH, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O YAHUAH our YAHUAH; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O YAHUAH, thou art our YAHUAH; let not man prevail against thee.
verses.am: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, {it is} nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou {art} our God; let not man prevail against thee. {man: or, mortal man}

verses.en: So YAHUAH smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Yehudah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.am: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

verses.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before YAHUAH, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
verses.am: And Asa and the people that {were} with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil. {destroyed: Heb. broken}

verses.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of YAHUAH came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
verses.am: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

verses.en: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the Spirit of YAHUAH came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.am: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

verses.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Yehudah and Benjamin; YAHUAH is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.am: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD {is} with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you. {to meet...: Heb. before Asa}

verses.en: Now for a long season Yisra'el hath been without the true YAHUAH, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.am: Now for a long season Israel {hath been} without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

verses.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.am: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

verses.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.am: And in those times {there was} no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations {were} upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

verses.en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for YAHUAH did vex them with all adversity.
verses.am: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity. {destroyed: Heb. beaten in pieces}

verses.en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.am: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

verses.en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Yehudah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of YAHUAH, that was before the porch of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that {was} before the porch of the LORD. {abominable...: Heb. abominations}

verses.en: And he gathered all Yehudah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Yisra'el in abundance, when they saw that YAHUAH his YAHUAH was with him.
verses.am: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God {was} with him.

verses.en: So they gathered themselves together at Yerushalayim in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.am: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.en: And they offered unto YAHUAH the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.am: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil {which} they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep. {the same...: Heb. in that day}

verses.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek YAHUAH of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.am: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

verses.en: That whosoever would not seek YAHUAH of Yisra'el should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.am: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

verses.en: And they sware unto YAHUAH with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.am: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

verses.en: And all Yehudah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and YAHUAH gave them rest round about.
verses.am: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

verses.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.am: And also {concerning} Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from {being} queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped {it}, and burnt {it} at the brook Kidron. {mother: that is, grandmother} {idol: Heb. horror}

verses.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Yisra'el: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.am: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

verses.en: And he brought into the house of YAHUAH the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.am: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.am: And there was no {more} war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Yisra'el came up against Yehudah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Yehudah.
verses.am: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of YAHUAH and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.am: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying, {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}

verses.en: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Yisra'el, that he may depart from me.
verses.am: {There is} a league between me and thee, as {there was} between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

verses.en: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Yisra'el; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.am: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali. {his: Heb. which were his}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard {it}, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

verses.en: Then Asa the king took all Yehudah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.am: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

verses.en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Yehudah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
verses.am: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

verses.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on YAHUAH, he delivered them into thine hand.
verses.am: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand. {a huge: Heb. in abundance}

verses.en: For the eyes of YAHUAH run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.am: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of {them} whose heart {is} perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars. {to shew...: or, strongly to hold with them, etc}

verses.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.am: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for {he was} in a rage with him because of this {thing}. And Asa oppressed {some} of the people the same time. {oppressed: Heb. crushed}

verses.en: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el.
verses.am: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to YAHUAH, but to the physicians.
verses.am: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease {was} exceeding {great}: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.

verses.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.am: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

verses.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of Dawid, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.am: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds {of spices} prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him. {had made: Heb. had digged}

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Yisra'el.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

verses.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Yehudah, and set garrisons in the land of Yehudah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.am: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

verses.en: And YAHUAH was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father Dawid, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.am: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim; {of...: or, of his father, and of David}

verses.en: But sought to YAHUAH of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Yisra'el.
verses.am: But sought to the {LORD} God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

verses.en: Therefore YAHUAH stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Yehudah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.am: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance. {brought: Heb. gave}

verses.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of YAHUAH: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Yehudah.
verses.am: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah. {was...: that is, was encouraged}

verses.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadyah, and to Zekaryah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, {even} to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

verses.en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.am: And with them {he sent} Levites, {even} Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

verses.en: And they taught in Yehudah, and had the book of the law of YAHUAH with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Yehudah, and taught the people.
verses.am: And they taught in Judah, and {had} the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

verses.en: And the fear of YAHUAH fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Yehudah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.am: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that {were} round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat. {fell: Heb. was}

verses.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.am: Also {some} of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Yehudah castles, and cities of store.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store. {castles: or, palaces}

verses.en: And he had much business in the cities of Yehudah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, {were} in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Yehudah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.am: And these {are} the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

verses.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.am: And next to him {was} Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand. {next...: Heb. at his hand}

verses.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto YAHUAH; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.am: And next him {was} Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

verses.en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.am: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

verses.en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.am: And next him {was} Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

verses.en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Yehudah.
verses.am: These waited on the king, beside {those} whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.am: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

verses.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
verses.am: And after {certain} years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that {he had} with him, and persuaded him to go up {with him} to Ramothgilead. {after...: Heb. at the end of years}

verses.en: And Ahab king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
verses.am: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I {am} as thou {art}, and my people as thy people; and {we will be} with thee in the war.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Yisra'el, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of YAHUAH to day.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

verses.en: Therefore the king of Yisra'el gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for YAHUAH will deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.am: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver {it} into the king's hand.

verses.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of YAHUAH besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.am: But Jehoshaphat said, {Is there} not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him? {besides: Heb. yet, or, more}

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of YAHUAH: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.am: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, {There is} yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same {is} Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.am: And the king of Israel called for one {of his} officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla. {officers: or, eunuchs} {Fetch...: Heb. Hasten}

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el and Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.am: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in {their} robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them. {void...: or, floor}

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith YAHUAH, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.am: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed. {they...: Heb. thou consume them}

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for YAHUAH shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.am: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver {it} into the hand of the king.

verses.en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
verses.am: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets {declare} good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good. {with...: Heb. with one mouth}

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As YAHUAH liveth, even what my YAHUAH saith, that will I speak.
verses.am: And Micaiah said, {As} the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

verses.en: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.am: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

verses.en: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of YAHUAH?
verses.am: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?

verses.en: Then he said, I did see all Yisra'el scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and YAHUAH said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.am: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return {therefore} every man to his house in peace.

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.am: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee {that} he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil? {but evil: or, but for evil}

verses.en: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of YAHUAH; I saw YAHUAH sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.am: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and {on} his left.

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Yisra'el, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.am: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

verses.en: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before YAHUAH, and said, I will entice him. And YAHUAH said unto him, Wherewith?
verses.am: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

verses.en: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And YAHUAH said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
verses.am: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And {the LORD} said, Thou shalt entice {him}, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do {even} so.

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, YAHUAH hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and YAHUAH hath spoken evil against thee.
verses.am: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

verses.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of YAHUAH from me to speak unto thee?
verses.am: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.am: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself. {into...: or, from chamber to chamber: Heb. a chamber in a chamber}

verses.en: Then the king of Yisra'el said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.am: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
verses.am: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this {fellow} in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not YAHUAH spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
verses.am: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, {then} hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

verses.en: So the king of Yisra'el and Jehoshaphat the king of Yehudah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.am: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Yisra'el disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
verses.am: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

verses.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that {were} with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Yisra'el. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and YAHUAH helped him; and YAHUAH moved them to depart from him.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It {is} the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them {to depart} from him.

verses.en: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yisra'el, they turned back again from pursuing him.
verses.am: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him. {from...: Heb. from after him}

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yisra'el between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.am: And a {certain} man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded. {at a venture: Heb. in his simplicity} {between...: Heb. between the joints and between the breastplate} {wounded: Heb. made sick}

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Yisra'el stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
verses.am: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed {himself} up in {his} chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Yehudah returned to his house in peace to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate YAHUAH? therefore is wrath upon thee from before YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore {is} wrath upon thee from before the LORD.

verses.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Yerushalayim: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers. {he went...: Heb. he returned and went out}

verses.en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Yehudah, city by city,
verses.am: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

verses.en: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for YAHUAH, who is with you in the judgment.
verses.am: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who {is} with you in the judgment. {in...: Heb. in the matter of judgment}

verses.en: Wherefore now let the fear of YAHUAH be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with YAHUAH our YAHUAH, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
verses.am: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do {it}: for {there is} no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

verses.en: Moreover in Yerushalayim did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Yisra'el, for the judgment of YAHUAH, and for controversies, when they returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and {of} the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of YAHUAH, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
verses.am: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

verses.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against YAHUAH, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
verses.am: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and {so} wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

verses.en: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of YAHUAH; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Yehudah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and YAHUAH shall be with the good.
verses.am: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest {is} over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites {shall be} officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good. {Deal...: Heb. Take courage and do}

verses.en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.am: It came to pass after this also, {that} the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them {other} beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

verses.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
verses.am: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they {be} in Hazazontamar, which {is} Engedi.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek YAHUAH, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Yehudah.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah. {himself: Heb. his face}

verses.en: And Yehudah gathered themselves together, to ask help of YAHUAH: even out of all the cities of Yehudah they came to seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask {help} of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, in the house of YAHUAH, before the new court,
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

verses.en: And said, O YAHUAH of our fathers, art not thou YAHUAH in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
verses.am: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, {art} not thou God in heaven? and rulest {not} thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand {is there not} power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

verses.en: Art not thou our YAHUAH, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Yisra'el, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
verses.am: {Art} not thou our God, {who} didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever? {who: Heb. thou}

verses.en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
verses.am: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

verses.en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
verses.am: If, {when} evil cometh upon us, {as} the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name {is} in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

verses.en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Yisra'el invade, when they came out of the land of Mitsrayim, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.am: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

verses.en: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
verses.am: Behold, {I say, how} they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

verses.en: O our YAHUAH, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
verses.am: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes {are} upon thee.

verses.en: And all Yehudah stood before YAHUAH, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.am: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

verses.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zekaryah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of YAHUAH in the midst of the congregation;
verses.am: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

verses.en: And he said, Hearken ye, all Yehudah, and ye inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith YAHUAH unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but YAHUAH's.
verses.am: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle {is} not yours, but God's.

verses.en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.am: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel. {cliff: Heb. ascent} {brook: or, valley}

verses.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of YAHUAH with you, O Yehudah and Yerushalayim: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for YAHUAH will be with you.
verses.am: Ye shall not {need} to fight in this {battle}: set yourselves, stand ye {still}, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD {will be} with you.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim fell before YAHUAH, worshipping YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with {his} face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.

verses.en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise YAHUAH of Yisra'el with a loud voice on high.
verses.am: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

verses.en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Yehudah, and ye inhabitants of Yerushalayim; Believe in YAHUAH your YAHUAH, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
verses.am: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

verses.en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto YAHUAH, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise YAHUAH; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy {endureth} for ever. {that...: Heb. praisers}

verses.en: And when they began to sing and to praise, YAHUAH set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Yehudah; and they were smitten.
verses.am: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten. {And when...: Heb. And in the time that they, etc} {to sing...: Heb. in singing and praise} {they were...: or, they smote one another}

verses.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.am: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy {them}: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another. {to destroy: Heb. for the destruction}

verses.en: And when Yehudah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.am: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they {were} dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped. {none...: Heb. there was not an escaping}

verses.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.am: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

verses.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed YAHUAH: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.am: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day. {Berachah: that is, blessing}

verses.en: Then they returned, every man of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Yerushalayim with joy; for YAHUAH had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.am: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies. {forefront: Heb. head}

verses.en: And they came to Yerushalayim with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.

verses.en: And the fear of YAHUAH was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that YAHUAH fought against the enemies of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of {those} countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

verses.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his YAHUAH gave him rest round about.
verses.am: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Yehudah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.am: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: {he was} thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD.

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who {is} mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel. {book of Jehu: Heb. words, etc} {is mentioned: Heb. was made to ascend}

verses.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah join himself with Ahaziah king of Yisra'el, who did very wickedly:
verses.am: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

verses.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.
verses.am: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.

verses.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, YAHUAH hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.am: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zekaryah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these {were} the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

verses.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Yehudah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.am: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he {was} the firstborn.

verses.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and {divers} also of the princes of Israel.

verses.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Jehoram {was} thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yisra'el, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought {that which was} evil in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.en: Howbeit YAHUAH would not destroy the house of Dawid, because of the covenant that he had made with Dawid, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.am: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever. {light: Heb. lamp, or, candle}

verses.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Yehudah, and made themselves a king.
verses.am: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king. {dominion: Heb. hand}

verses.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.am: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

verses.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Yehudah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken YAHUAH of his fathers.
verses.am: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time {also} did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

verses.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Yehudah, and caused the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to commit fornication, and compelled Yehudah thereto.
verses.am: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah {thereto}.

verses.en: And there came a writing to him from Eliyahu the prophet, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH of Dawid thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Yehudah,
verses.am: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

verses.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Yisra'el, and hast made Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
verses.am: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, {which were} better than thyself:

verses.en: Behold, with a great plague will YAHUAH smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.am: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods: {a great...: Heb. a great stroke}

verses.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.am: And thou {shalt have} great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

verses.en: Moreover YAHUAH stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.am: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that {were} near the Ethiopians:

verses.en: And they came up into Yehudah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
