verses.am: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons. {carried...: Heb. carried captive} {Jehoahaz: also called, Ahaziah, or, Azariah}

verses.en: And after all this YAHUAH smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.am: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.am: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

verses.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Yerushalayim eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of Dawid, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.am: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings. {without...: Heb. without desire}

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Yerushalayim made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah reigned.
verses.am: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

verses.en: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.am: Forty and two years old {was} Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

verses.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.am: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

verses.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of YAHUAH like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.am: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

verses.en: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Yisra'el to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.am: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

verses.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.am: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick. {which...: Heb. wherewith they wounded him} {Azariah: also called, Ahaziah, or, Jehoahaz}

verses.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of YAHUAH by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom YAHUAH had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.am: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab. {destruction: Heb. treading down}

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Yehudah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.am: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

verses.en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought YAHUAH with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
verses.am: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he {is} the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

verses.en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Yehudah.
verses.am: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

verses.en: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
verses.am: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not. {Jehoshabeath: also called, Jehosheba}

verses.en: And he was with them hid in the house of YAHUAH six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.am: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.

verses.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.am: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

verses.en: And they went about in Yehudah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Yehudah, and the chief of the fathers of Yisra'el, and they came to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of YAHUAH. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as YAHUAH hath said of the sons of Dawid.
verses.am: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.

verses.en: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
verses.am: This {is} the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, {shall be} porters of the doors; {doors: Heb. thresholds}

verses.en: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And a third part {shall be} at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people {shall be} in the courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.en: But let none come into the house of YAHUAH, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of YAHUAH.
verses.am: But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they {are} holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.

verses.en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
verses.am: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever {else} cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

verses.en: So the Levites and all Yehudah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.am: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go {out} on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

verses.en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king Dawid's, which were in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that {had been} king David's, which {were} in the house of God.

verses.en: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.am: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about. {side: Heb. shoulder} {temple: Heb. house}

verses.en: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, YAHUAH save the king.
verses.am: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and {gave him} the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king. {God...: Heb. Let the king live}

verses.en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of YAHUAH:
verses.am: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:

verses.en: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.am: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason. {Treason: Heb. Conspiracy}

verses.en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.

verses.en: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
verses.am: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.

verses.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be YAHUAH's people.
verses.am: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD'S people.

verses.en: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.am: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

verses.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of YAHUAH by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom Dawid had distributed in the house of YAHUAH, to offer the burnt offerings of YAHUAH, as it is written in the law of Mosheh, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by Dawid.
verses.am: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as {it is} written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, {as it was ordained} by David. {as it was...: Heb. by the hands of David}

verses.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of YAHUAH, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.am: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none {which was} unclean in any thing should enter in.

verses.en: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of YAHUAH: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.am: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

verses.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.am: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

verses.en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.am: Joash {was} seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Zibiah of Beersheba.

verses.en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.am: And Joash did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

verses.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.am: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, {that} Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD. {to repair: Heb. to renew}

verses.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Yehudah, and gather of all Yisra'el money to repair the house of your YAHUAH from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
verses.am: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened {it} not.

verses.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Yehudah and out of Yerushalayim the collection, according to the commandment of Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH, and of the congregation of Yisra'el, for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.am: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, {according to the commandment} of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

verses.en: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of YAHUAH; and also all the dedicated things of the house of YAHUAH did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.am: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.

verses.en: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.en: And they made a proclamation through Yehudah and Yerushalayim, to bring in to YAHUAH the collection that Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH laid upon Yisra'el in the wilderness.
verses.am: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection {that} Moses the servant of God {laid} upon Israel in the wilderness. {a proclamation: Heb. a voice}

verses.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.am: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

verses.en: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.am: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that {there was} much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

verses.en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of YAHUAH, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of YAHUAH, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.

verses.en: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of YAHUAH in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.am: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it. {the work...: Heb. the healing went up upon the work}

verses.en: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of YAHUAH, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of YAHUAH continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.am: And when they had finished {it}, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, {even} vessels to minister, and to offer {withal}, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada. {to offer...: or, pestils}

verses.en: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
verses.am: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old {was he} when he died.

verses.en: And they buried him in the city of Dawid among the kings, because he had done good in Yisra'el, both toward YAHUAH, and toward his house.
verses.am: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

verses.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Yehudah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.am: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.

verses.en: And they left the house of YAHUAH of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Yehudah and Yerushalayim for this their trespass.
verses.am: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

verses.en: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto YAHUAH; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.am: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

verses.en: And the Spirit of YAHUAH came upon Zekaryah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH, Why transgress ye the commandments of YAHUAH, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken YAHUAH, he hath also forsaken you.
verses.am: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you. {came...: Heb. clothed}

verses.en: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.

verses.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, YAHUAH look upon it, and require it.
verses.am: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon {it}, and require {it}.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.am: And it came to pass at the end of the year, {that} the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus. {at the...: Heb. in the revolution of the year} {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}

verses.en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and YAHUAH delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken YAHUAH of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.am: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

verses.en: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of Dawid, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.am: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

verses.en: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.am: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess. {Zabad: or, Jozacher} {Shimrith: or, Shomer}

verses.en: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of YAHUAH, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: Now {concerning} his sons, and the greatness of the burdens {laid} upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they {are} written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead. {repairing: Heb. founding} {story: or, commentary}

verses.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Amaziah {was} twenty and five years old {when} he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, but not with a perfect heart.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.am: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father. {established...: Heb. confirmed upon him}

verses.en: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Mosheh, where YAHUAH commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.am: But he slew not their children, but {did} as {it is} written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

verses.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Yehudah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Yehudah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.am: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of {their} fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice {men, able} to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

verses.en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Yisra'el for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.am: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

verses.en: But there came a man of YAHUAH to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Yisra'el go with thee; for YAHUAH is not with Yisra'el, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
verses.am: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD {is} not with Israel, {to wit, with} all the children of Ephraim.

verses.en: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: YAHUAH shall make thee fall before the enemy: for YAHUAH hath power to help, and to cast down.
verses.am: But if thou wilt go, do {it}, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

verses.en: And Amaziah said to the man of YAHUAH, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Yisra'el? And the man of YAHUAH answered, YAHUAH is able to give thee much more than this.
verses.am: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this. {army: Heb. band}

verses.en: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Yehudah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.am: Then Amaziah separated them, {to wit}, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger. {home again: Heb. to their place} {in great...: Heb. in heat of anger}

verses.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.am: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

verses.en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Yehudah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.am: And {other} ten thousand {left} alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

verses.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Yehudah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.am: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil. {the soldiers...: Heb. the sons of the band}

verses.en: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the elohim of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his elohim, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.am: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up {to be} his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

verses.en: Wherefore the anger of YAHUAH was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the elohim of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
verses.am: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that YAHUAH hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.am: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that {the king} said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel. {determined: Heb. counselled}

verses.en: Then Amaziah king of Yehudah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Yisra'el, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.am: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

verses.en: And Joash king of Yisra'el sent to Amaziah king of Yehudah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.am: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that {was} in Lebanon sent to the cedar that {was} in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that {was} in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle. {thistle: or, furze bush, or, thorn} {a wild...: Heb. a beast of the field}

verses.en: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Yehudah with thee?
verses.am: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to {thine} hurt, that thou shouldest fall, {even} thou, and Judah with thee?

verses.en: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of YAHUAH, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the elohim of Edom.
verses.am: But Amaziah would not hear; for it {came} of God, that he might deliver them into the hand {of their enemies}, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

verses.en: So Joash the king of Yisra'el went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Yehudah, at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Yehudah.
verses.am: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, {both} he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which {belongeth} to Judah.

verses.en: And Yehudah was put to the worse before Yisra'el, and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.am: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent. {put...: Heb. smitten}

verses.en: And Joash the king of Yisra'el took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Yerushalayim, and brake down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.am: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits. {the corner...: Heb. the gate of it that looketh}

verses.en: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of YAHUAH with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
verses.am: And {he took} all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

verses.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yehudah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yisra'el fifteen years.
verses.am: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el?
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, {are} they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

verses.en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following YAHUAH they made a conspiracy against him in Yerushalayim; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
verses.am: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there. {from...: Heb. from after} {made...: Heb. conspired a conspiracy}

verses.en: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Yehudah.
verses.am: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah. {Judah: that is, the city of David}

verses.en: Then all the people of Yehudah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.am: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who {was} sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah. {Uzziah: or, Azariah}

verses.en: He built Eloth, and restored it to Yehudah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.am: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Sixteen years old {was} Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

verses.en: And he sought YAHUAH in the days of Zekaryah, who had understanding in the visions of YAHUAH: and as long as he sought YAHUAH, YAHUAH made him to prosper.
verses.am: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper. {in the visions...: Heb. in the seeing of God}

verses.en: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
verses.am: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines. {about...: or, in the country of Ashdod}

verses.en: And YAHUAH helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.
verses.am: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.

verses.en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Mitsrayim; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
verses.am: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad {even} to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened {himself} exceedingly. {spread...: Heb. went}

verses.en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Yerushalayim at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
verses.am: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning {of the wall}, and fortified them. {fortified: or, repaired}

verses.en: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
verses.am: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen {also}, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry. {digged...: or, cut out many cisterns} {Carmel: or, fruitful fields} {husbandry: Heb. ground}

verses.en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
verses.am: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, {one} of the king's captains.

verses.en: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
verses.am: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour {were} two thousand and six hundred.

verses.en: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.am: And under their hand {was} an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy. {an army: Heb. the power of an army}

verses.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
verses.am: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings {to cast} stones. {slings...: Heb. stones of slings}

verses.en: And he made in Yerushalayim engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
verses.am: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong. {spread: Heb. went forth}

verses.en: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against YAHUAH his YAHUAH, and went into the temple of YAHUAH to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
verses.am: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to {his} destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

verses.en: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of YAHUAH, that were valiant men:
verses.am: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD, {that were} valiant men:

verses.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto YAHUAH, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, {It appertaineth} not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither {shall it be} for thine honour from the LORD God.

verses.en: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of YAHUAH, from beside the incense altar.
verses.am: Then Uzziah was wroth, and {had} a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.

verses.en: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because YAHUAH had smitten him.
verses.am: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he {was} leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

verses.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of YAHUAH: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
verses.am: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, {being} a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son {was} over the king's house, judging the people of the land. {several: Heb. free}

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

verses.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which {belonged} to the kings; for they said, He {is} a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.am: Jotham {was} twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of YAHUAH. And the people did yet corruptly.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.

verses.en: He built the high gate of the house of YAHUAH, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
verses.am: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much. {Ophel: or, the tower}

verses.en: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Yehudah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
verses.am: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

verses.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
verses.am: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third. {So...: Heb. This}

verses.en: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before YAHUAH his YAHUAH.
verses.am: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God. {prepared: or, established}

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el and Yehudah.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: but he did not that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, like Dawid his father:
verses.am: Ahaz {was} twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:

verses.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Yisra'el, and made also molten images for Baalim.
verses.am: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

verses.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom YAHUAH had cast out before the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel. {burnt...: or, offered sacrifice}

verses.en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.am: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.en: Wherefore YAHUAH his YAHUAH delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Yisra'el, who smote him with a great slaughter.
verses.am: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought {them} to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter. {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}

verses.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Yehudah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, {which were} all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. {valiant...: Heb. sons of valour}

verses.en: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
verses.am: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah {that was} next to the king. {next...: Heb. the second to the king}

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.am: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

verses.en: But a prophet of YAHUAH was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because YAHUAH of your fathers was wroth with Yehudah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
verses.am: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name {was} Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage {that} reacheth up unto heaven.

verses.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Yehudah and Yerushalayim for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against YAHUAH your YAHUAH?
verses.am: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: {but are there} not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

verses.en: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of YAHUAH is upon you.
verses.am: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD {is} upon you.

verses.en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
verses.am: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against YAHUAH already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Yisra'el.
verses.am: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD {already}, ye intend to add {more} to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and {there is} fierce wrath against Israel.

verses.en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
verses.am: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

verses.en: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
verses.am: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

verses.en: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.am: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

verses.en: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Yehudah, and carried away captives.
verses.am: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives. {captives: Heb. a captivity}

verses.en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Yehudah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
verses.am: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

verses.en: For YAHUAH brought Yehudah low because of Ahaz king of Yisra'el; for he made Yehudah naked, and transgressed sore against YAHUAH.
verses.am: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.

verses.en: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
verses.am: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

verses.en: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of YAHUAH, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
verses.am: For Ahaz took away a portion {out} of the house of the LORD, and {out} of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave {it} unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

verses.en: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against YAHUAH: this is that king Ahaz.
verses.am: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this {is that} king Ahaz.

verses.en: For he sacrificed unto the elohim of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the elohim of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Yisra'el.
verses.am: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, {therefore} will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel. {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}

verses.en: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of YAHUAH, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of YAHUAH, and shut up the doors of the house of YAHUAH, and he made him altars in every corner of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And in every several city of Yehudah he made high places to burn incense unto other elohim, and provoked to anger YAHUAH of his fathers.
verses.am: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers. {to burn: or, to offer}

verses.en: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Yerushalayim: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Yisra'el: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, {even} in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zekaryah.
verses.am: Hezekiah began to reign {when he was} five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, according to all that Dawid his father had done.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

verses.en: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of YAHUAH, and repaired them.
verses.am: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.

verses.en: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
verses.am: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

verses.en: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of YAHUAH of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
verses.am: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy {place}.

verses.en: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of YAHUAH, and turned their backs.
verses.am: For our fathers have trespassed, and done {that which was} evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned {their} backs. {turned their...: Heb. given the neck}

verses.en: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy {place} unto the God of Israel.

verses.en: Wherefore the wrath of YAHUAH was upon Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
verses.am: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes. {trouble: Heb. commotion}

verses.en: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.am: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives {are} in captivity for this.

verses.en: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with YAHUAH of Yisra'el, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.am: Now {it is} in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

verses.en: My sons, be not now negligent: for YAHUAH hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
verses.am: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense. {be not...: or, be not now deceived} {burn...: or, offer sacrifice}

verses.en: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Yo'el the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
verses.am: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

verses.en: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zekaryah, and Mattaniah:
verses.am: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

verses.en: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
verses.am: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

verses.en: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of YAHUAH, to cleanse the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD. {by the words...: or, in the business of the LORD}

verses.en: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of YAHUAH, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of YAHUAH into the court of the house of YAHUAH. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
verses.am: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse {it}, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took {it}, to carry {it} out abroad into the brook Kidron.

verses.en: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of YAHUAH: so they sanctified the house of YAHUAH in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
verses.am: Now they began on the first {day} of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

verses.en: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of YAHUAH, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
verses.am: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

verses.en: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they {are} before the altar of the LORD.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

verses.en: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Yehudah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer {them} on the altar of the LORD.

verses.en: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
verses.am: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled {it} on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

verses.en: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
verses.am: And they brought forth the he goats {for} the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them: {forth: Heb. near}

verses.en: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Yisra'el: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Yisra'el.
verses.am: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded {that} the burnt offering and the sin offering {should be made} for all Israel.

verses.en: And he set the Levites in the house of YAHUAH with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of Dawid, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of YAHUAH by his prophets.
verses.am: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for {so was} the commandment of the LORD by his prophets. {commandment of the LORD: Heb. commandment by the hand of the LORD} {by: Heb. by the hand of}

verses.en: And the Levites stood with the instruments of Dawid, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.am: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

verses.en: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of YAHUAH began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by Dawid king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began {also} with the trumpets, and with the instruments {ordained} by David king of Israel. {when: Heb. in the time} {the instruments: Heb. hands of instruments}

verses.en: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.am: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: {and} all {this continued} until the burnt offering was finished. {singers: Heb. song}

verses.en: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
verses.am: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped. {present: Heb. found}

verses.en: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto YAHUAH with the words of Dawid, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.am: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto YAHUAH, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of YAHUAH. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings. {consecrated...: or, filled your hand}

verses.en: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, {and} two hundred lambs: all these {were} for a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.en: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
verses.am: And the consecrated things {were} six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.en: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

verses.en: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of YAHUAH was set in order.
verses.am: And also the burnt offerings {were} in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for {every} burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

verses.en: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that YAHUAH had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
