verses.en: And Hezekiah sent to all Yisra'el and Yehudah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of YAHUAH at Yerushalayim, to keep the passover unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Yerushalayim, to keep the passover in the second month.
verses.am: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

verses.en: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
verses.am: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation. {pleased...: Heb. was right in the eyes of the king}

verses.en: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Yisra'el, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el at Yerushalayim: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
verses.am: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done {it} of a long {time in such sort} as it was written.

verses.en: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Yisra'el and Yehudah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Yisra'el, turn again unto YAHUAH of Abraham, Yitschaq, and Yisra'el, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.am: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria. {from: Heb. from the hand}

verses.en: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against YAHUAH of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
verses.am: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, {who} therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

verses.en: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto YAHUAH, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve YAHUAH your YAHUAH, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
verses.am: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers {were, but} yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you. {be ye...: Heb. harden not your necks} {yield...: Heb. give the hand}

verses.en: For if ye turn again unto YAHUAH, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for YAHUAH your YAHUAH is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
verses.am: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children {shall find} compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God {is} gracious and merciful, and will not turn away {his} face from you, if ye return unto him.

verses.en: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
verses.am: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

verses.en: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Also in Yehudah the hand of YAHUAH was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.

verses.en: And there assembled at Yerushalayim much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
verses.am: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

verses.en: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Yerushalayim, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
verses.am: And they arose and took away the altars that {were} in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast {them} into the brook Kidron.

verses.en: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth {day} of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

verses.en: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Mosheh the man of YAHUAH: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
verses.am: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, {which they received} of the hand of the Levites. {their place: Heb. their standing}

verses.en: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: For {there were} many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one {that was} not clean, to sanctify {them} unto the LORD.

verses.en: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good YAHUAH pardon every one
verses.am: For a multitude of the people, {even} many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

verses.en: That prepareth his heart to seek YAHUAH, YAHUAH of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
verses.am: {That} prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though {he be} not {cleansed} according to the purification of the sanctuary.

verses.en: And YAHUAH hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.am: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el that were present at Yerushalayim kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised YAHUAH day by day, singing with loud instruments unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, {singing} with loud instruments unto the LORD. {present: Heb. found} {loud...: Heb. instruments of strength}

verses.en: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of YAHUAH: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers. {comfortably...: Heb. to the heart of all}

verses.en: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
verses.am: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept {other} seven days with gladness.

verses.en: For Hezekiah king of Yehudah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.am: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves. {did give: Heb. lifted up, or, offered} {gave: Heb. lifted up, or, offered}

verses.en: And all the congregation of Yehudah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Yisra'el, and the strangers that came out of the land of Yisra'el, and that dwelt in Yehudah, rejoiced.
verses.am: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

verses.en: So there was great joy in Yerushalayim: for since the time of Shelomoh the son of Dawid king of Yisra'el there was not the like in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel {there was} not the like in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
verses.am: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came {up} to his holy dwelling place, {even} unto heaven. {his holy...: Heb. the habitation of his holiness}

verses.en: Now when all this was finished, all Yisra'el that were present went out to the cities of Yehudah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Yehudah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Yisra'el returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
verses.am: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities. {present: Heb. found} {images: Heb. statues} {until...: Heb. until to make an end}

verses.en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

verses.en: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of YAHUAH.
verses.am: {He appointed} also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, {to wit}, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as {it is} written in the law of the LORD.

verses.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Yerushalayim to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

verses.en: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Yisra'el brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
verses.am: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all {things} brought they in abundantly. {came...: Heb. brake forth} {honey: or, dates}

verses.en: And concerning the children of Yisra'el and Yehudah, that dwelt in the cities of Yehudah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto YAHUAH their YAHUAH, and laid them by heaps.
verses.am: And {concerning} the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid {them} by heaps. {by heaps: Heb. heaps, heaps}

verses.en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
verses.am: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished {them} in the seventh month.

verses.en: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed YAHUAH, and his people Yisra'el.
verses.am: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
verses.am: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

verses.en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of YAHUAH, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for YAHUAH hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
verses.am: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since {the people} began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left {is} this great store.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of YAHUAH; and they prepared them,
verses.am: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared {them}, {chambers: or, storehouses}

verses.en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
verses.am: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated {things} faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite {was} ruler, and Shimei his brother {was} the next.

verses.en: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, {were} overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God. {under...: Heb. at the hand}

verses.en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of YAHUAH, to distribute the oblations of YAHUAH, and the most holy things.
verses.am: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, {was} over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.

verses.en: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
verses.am: And next him {were} Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in {their} set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small: {next...: Heb. at his hand} {set...: or, trust}

verses.en: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of YAHUAH, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
verses.am: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, {even} unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

verses.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
verses.am: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

verses.en: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
verses.am: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness: {set...: or, trust}

verses.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
verses.am: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, {which were} in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

verses.en: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Yehudah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before YAHUAH his YAHUAH.
verses.am: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought {that which was} good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

verses.en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of YAHUAH, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his YAHUAH, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
verses.am: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did {it} with all his heart, and prospered.

verses.en: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Yehudah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
verses.am: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself. {to win...: Heb. to break them up}

verses.en: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Yerushalayim,
verses.am: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem, {he was...: Heb. his face was to war}

verses.en: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
verses.am: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which {were} without the city: and they did help him.

verses.en: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
verses.am: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water? {ran: Heb. overflowed}

verses.en: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of Dawid, and made darts and shields in abundance.
verses.am: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised {it} up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo {in} the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance. {darts: or, swords, or, weapons}

verses.en: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
verses.am: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying, {spake...: Heb. he spoke to their heart}

verses.en: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
verses.am: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that {is} with him: for {there be} more with us than with him:

verses.en: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is YAHUAH our YAHUAH to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Yehudah.
verses.am: With him {is} an arm of flesh; but with us {is} the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah. {rested...: Heb. leaned}

verses.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Yerushalayim, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Yehudah, and unto all Yehudah that were at Yerushalayim, saying,
verses.am: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he {himself laid siege} against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that {were} at Jerusalem, saying, {power: Heb. dominion}

verses.en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Yerushalayim?
verses.am: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem? {siege: or, strong hold}

verses.en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, YAHUAH our YAHUAH shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.am: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Yehudah and Yerushalayim, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
verses.am: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

verses.en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the elohim of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
verses.am: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of {other} lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

verses.en: Who was there among all the elohim of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your YAHUAH should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
verses.am: Who {was there} among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

verses.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your YAHUAH deliver you out of mine hand?
verses.am: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

verses.en: And his servants spake yet more against YAHUAH, and against his servant Hezekiah.
verses.am: And his servants spake yet {more} against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

verses.en: He wrote also letters to rail on YAHUAH of Yisra'el, and to speak against him, saying, As the elohim of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not YAHUAH of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
verses.am: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of {other} lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

verses.en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Yehudim' speech unto the people of Yerushalayim that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
verses.am: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that {were} on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

verses.en: And they spake against YAHUAH of Yerushalayim, as against the elohim of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
verses.am: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, {which were} the work of the hands of man.

verses.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Yeshayahu the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
verses.am: And for this {cause} Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

verses.en: And YAHUAH sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
verses.am: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword. {slew...: Heb. made him fall}

verses.en: Thus YAHUAH saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
verses.am: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all {other}, and guided them on every side.

verses.en: And many brought gifts unto YAHUAH to Yerushalayim, and presents to Hezekiah king of Yehudah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
verses.am: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth. {presents: Heb. precious things}

verses.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto YAHUAH: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
verses.am: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign. {gave...: or, wrought a miracle for him}

verses.en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
verses.am: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit {done} unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, so that the wrath of YAHUAH came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
verses.am: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, {both} he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah. {pride: Heb. lifting up}

verses.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
verses.am: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels; {pleasant...: Heb. instruments of desire}

verses.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
verses.am: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

verses.en: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for YAHUAH had given him substance very much.
verses.am: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

verses.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of Dawid. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
verses.am: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

verses.en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babel, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, YAHUAH left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
verses.am: Howbeit in {the business of} the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was {done} in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all {that was} in his heart. {ambassadors: Heb. interpreters}

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they {are} written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, {and} in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel. {goodness: Heb. kindnesses}

verses.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of Dawid: and all Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead. {chiefest: or, highest}

verses.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Yerushalayim:
verses.am: Manasseh {was} twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

verses.en: But did that which was evil in the sight of YAHUAH, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom YAHUAH had cast out before the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: But did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.am: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them. {he built...: Heb. he returned and built}

verses.en: Also he built altars in the house of YAHUAH, whereof YAHUAH had said, In Yerushalayim shall my name be for ever.
verses.am: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

verses.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of YAHUAH, to provoke him to anger.
verses.am: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

verses.en: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of YAHUAH, of which YAHUAH had said to Dawid and to Shelomoh his son, In this house, and in Yerushalayim, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Yisra'el, will I put my name for ever:
verses.am: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

verses.en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Yisra'el from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

verses.en: So Manasseh made Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom YAHUAH had destroyed before the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, {and} to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
verses.am: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

verses.en: Wherefore YAHUAH brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babel.
verses.am: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon. {of the king: Heb. which were the king's} {fetters: or, chains}

verses.en: And when he was in affliction, he besought YAHUAH his YAHUAH, and humbled himself greatly before YAHUAH of his fathers,
verses.am: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

verses.en: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Yerushalayim into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that YAHUAH he was YAHUAH.
verses.am: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he {was} God.

verses.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of Dawid, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah. {Ophel: or, the tower}

verses.en: And he took away the strange elohim, and the idol out of the house of YAHUAH, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of YAHUAH, and in Yerushalayim, and cast them out of the city.
verses.am: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast {them} out of the city.

verses.en: And he repaired the altar of YAHUAH, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Yehudah to serve YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto YAHUAH their YAHUAH only.
verses.am: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, {yet} unto the LORD their God only.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his YAHUAH, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of YAHUAH of Yisra'el, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they {are written} in the book of the kings of Israel.

verses.en: His prayer also, and how YAHUAH was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.
verses.am: His prayer also, and {how God} was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they {are} written among the sayings of the seers. {the seers: or, Hosai}

verses.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Amon {was} two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

verses.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of YAHUAH, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
verses.am: But he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

verses.en: And humbled not himself before YAHUAH, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
verses.am: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more. {trespassed more and more: Heb. multiplied trespass}

verses.en: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
verses.am: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

verses.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.am: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Yerushalayim one and thirty years.
verses.am: Josiah {was} eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, and walked in the ways of Dawid his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined {neither} to the right hand, nor to the left.

verses.en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after YAHUAH of Dawid his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Yehudah and Yerushalayim from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
verses.am: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

verses.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
verses.am: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that {were} on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust {of them}, and strowed {it} upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them. {the images: or, the sun images} {graves: Heb. face of the graves}

verses.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
verses.am: And {so did he} in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about. {mattocks: or, mauls}

verses.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Yisra'el, he returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem. {into...: Heb. to make powder}

verses.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of YAHUAH his YAHUAH.
verses.am: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

verses.en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of YAHUAH, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Yisra'el, and of all Yehudah and Benjamin; and they returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of YAHUAH, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of YAHUAH, to repair and amend the house:
verses.am: And they put {it} in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:

verses.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Yehudah had destroyed.
verses.am: Even to the artificers and builders gave they {it}, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed. {to floor: or, to rafter}

verses.en: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadyah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zekaryah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
verses.am: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them {were} Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set {it} forward; and {other of} the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

verses.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
verses.am: Also {they were} over the bearers of burdens, and {were} overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites {there were} scribes, and officers, and porters.

verses.en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of YAHUAH, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of YAHUAH given by Mosheh.
verses.am: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD {given} by Moses. {by: Heb. by the hand of}

verses.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of YAHUAH. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
verses.am: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

verses.en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
verses.am: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do {it}. {to thy...: Heb. to the hand of, etc}

verses.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of YAHUAH, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
verses.am: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen. {gathered together: Heb. poured out, or, melted}

verses.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.am: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king. {it: Heb. in it}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Mikah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,
verses.am: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying, {Abdon: or, Achbor}

verses.en: Go, enquire of YAHUAH for me, and for them that are left in Yisra'el and in Yehudah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of YAHUAH that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of YAHUAH, to do after all that is written in this book.
verses.am: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great {is} the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

verses.en: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Yerushalayim in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
verses.am: And Hilkiah, and {they} that the king {had appointed}, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that {effect}. {Hasrah: also called, Harhas} {wardrobe: Heb. garments} {in the college: or, in the school, or, in the second part}

verses.en: And she answered them, Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
verses.am: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Yehudah:
verses.am: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, {even} all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

verses.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other elohim, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.am: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.en: And as for the king of Yehudah, who sent you to enquire of YAHUAH, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el concerning the words which thou hast heard;
verses.am: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel {concerning} the words which thou hast heard;

verses.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before YAHUAH, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard {thee} also, saith the LORD.

verses.en: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
verses.am: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

verses.en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the king went up into the house of YAHUAH, and all the men of Yehudah, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD. {great...: Heb. from great even to small}

verses.en: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before YAHUAH, to walk after YAHUAH, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
verses.am: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

verses.en: And he caused all that were present in Yerushalayim and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Yerushalayim did according to the covenant of YAHUAH, YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand {to it}. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers. {present: Heb. found}

verses.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Yisra'el, and made all that were present in Yisra'el to serve, even to serve YAHUAH their YAHUAH. And all his days they departed not from following YAHUAH, YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that {pertained} to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, {even} to serve the LORD their God. {And} all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers. {present: Heb. found} {from...: Heb. from after}

verses.en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto YAHUAH in Yerushalayim: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.am: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth {day} of the first month.

verses.en: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of YAHUAH,
verses.am: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,

verses.en: And said unto the Levites that taught all Yisra'el, which were holy unto YAHUAH, Put the holy ark in the house which Shelomoh the son of Dawid king of Yisra'el did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now YAHUAH your YAHUAH, and his people Yisra'el,
verses.am: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; {it shall} not {be} a burden upon {your} shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

verses.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of Dawid king of Yisra'el, and according to the writing of Shelomoh his son.
verses.am: And prepare {yourselves} by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

verses.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
verses.am: And stand in the holy {place} according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and {after} the division of the families of the Levites. {the families of the fathers: Heb. the house of the fathers} {the people: Heb. the sons of the people}

verses.en: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of YAHUAH by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that {they} may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.en: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.
verses.am: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these {were} of the king's substance. {gave: Heb. offered}

verses.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zekaryah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of YAHUAH, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
verses.am: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred {small cattle}, and three hundred oxen. {gave willingly: Heb. offered, etc}

verses.en: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
verses.am: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand {small cattle}, and five hundred oxen. {gave: Heb. offered}

verses.en: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.
verses.am: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

verses.en: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
verses.am: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled {the blood} from their hands, and the Levites flayed {them}.

verses.en: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto YAHUAH, as it is written in the book of Mosheh. And so did they with the oxen.
verses.am: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as {it is} written in the book of Moses. And so {did they} with the oxen.

verses.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
verses.am: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the {other} holy {offerings} sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided {them} speedily among all the people. {divided...: Heb. made them run}

verses.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
verses.am: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron {were busied} in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

verses.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of Dawid, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
verses.am: And the singers the sons of Asaph {were} in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters {waited} at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them. {place: Heb. station}

verses.en: So all the service of YAHUAH was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of YAHUAH, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
verses.am: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
verses.am: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days. {present: Heb. found}

verses.en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Yisra'el from the days of Shemu'el the prophet; neither did all the kings of Yisra'el keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Yehudah and Yisra'el that were present, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. {present: Heb. found}

verses.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
verses.am: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

verses.en: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Mitsrayim came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
verses.am: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him. {temple: Heb. house}

verses.en: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Yehudah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for YAHUAH commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with YAHUAH, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.
verses.am: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? {I come} not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from {meddling with} God, who {is} with me, that he destroy thee not. {the house...: Heb. the house of my war}

verses.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of YAHUAH, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.am: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

verses.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
verses.am: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded. {wounded: Heb. made sick}

verses.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Yerushalayim, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Yehudah and Yerushalayim mourned for Josiah.
verses.am: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in {one of} the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah. {in one...: or, among the sepulchres}

verses.en: And Yirmeyahu lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Yisra'el: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
verses.am: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they {are} written in the lamentations.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of YAHUAH,
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to {that which was} written in the law of the LORD, {goodness: Heb. kindnesses}

verses.en: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el and Yehudah.
verses.am: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Jehoahaz {was} twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the king of Mitsrayim put him down at Yerushalayim, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.am: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold. {put...: Heb. removed him}

verses.en: And the king of Mitsrayim made Eliakim his brother king over Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Mitsrayim.
verses.am: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

verses.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim: and he did that which was evil in the sight of YAHUAH his YAHUAH.
verses.am: Jehoiakim {was} twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

verses.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babel.
verses.am: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon. {fetters: or, chains}

verses.en: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of YAHUAH to Babel, and put them in his temple at Babel.
verses.am: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el and Yehudah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead. {Jehoiachin: also called, Jeconiah, or, Coniah}

verses.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Yerushalayim: and he did that which was evil in the sight of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Jehoiachin {was} eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.en: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babel, with the goodly vessels of the house of YAHUAH, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem. {when...: Heb. at the return of the year} {goodly...: Heb. vessels of desire} {Zedekiah...: or, Mattaniah, his father's brother}

verses.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Zedekiah {was} one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of YAHUAH his YAHUAH, and humbled not himself before Yirmeyahu the prophet speaking from the mouth of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD his God, {and} humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet {speaking} from the mouth of the LORD.

verses.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by YAHUAH: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.en: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of YAHUAH which he had hallowed in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And YAHUAH of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
verses.am: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place: {by: Heb. by the hand of} {betimes: that is, continually and carefully}

verses.en: But they mocked the messengers of YAHUAH, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of YAHUAH arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
verses.am: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till {there was} no remedy. {remedy: Heb. healing}

verses.en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.
verses.am: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave {them} all into his hand.

verses.en: And all the vessels of the house of YAHUAH, great and small, and the treasures of the house of YAHUAH, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babel.
verses.am: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all {these} he brought to Babylon.

verses.en: And they burnt the house of YAHUAH, and brake down the wall of Yerushalayim, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
verses.am: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

verses.en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babel; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
verses.am: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia: {them...: Heb. the remainder from the sword}

verses.en: To fulfil the word of YAHUAH by the mouth of Yirmeyahu, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
verses.am: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: {for} as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

verses.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of YAHUAH spoken by the mouth of Yirmeyahu might be accomplished, YAHUAH stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.am: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD {spoken} by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and {put it} also in writing, saying,

verses.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath YAHUAH of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah. Who is there among you of all his people? YAHUAH his YAHUAH be with him, and let him go up.
verses.am: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which {is} in Judah. Who {is there} among you of all his people? The LORD his God {be} with him, and let him go up.
